evidence: With the DaLiA threshold frozen, WESAD retained 85.2% of 5,544 eligible windows. Subject-averaged absolute error among reported ECG-readable windows was 6.83 bpm.
next_decision: Choose the reporting threshold using both per-person error and maximum no-readout time. Verify the policy in intended activities and hardware before relying on a new deployment.
boundary: The ECG reference is algorithm-derived. The external cohort changes the activity setting; both studies use Empatica wrist hardware. Reported accuracy applies only to the activity and ECG eligibility definitions.
